notes.title: Wicce Upadate Notes - 6/3/2021
notes.content:
Hello, this is CFK.

We are excited to announce that 「Wicce」 has been released on Nintendo Switch today(June 3)!
Thus, 「Wicce」 for Steam will be updated to the same version as the Nintendo Switch edition.

However, we are also retaining the former 「Wicce」 so that customers can still enjoy the classic version.

You can play 「Wicce」's classic version by following the steps below:

Run Steam
Library → Wicce → Right-Mouse Click → Select "Properties"
Beta → Select "legacy – Old Version"
Check that Wicce [legacy] has been set → Run the classic version


Please note that the classic version's save file will not be compatible with the updated game.

We ask that you pay extra attention to whether the save file you selected is compatible with the version of the game you are playing.

We the members of CFK deeply appreciate your interest in 「Wicce」,
and your time on playing the game.

We will keep up the hard work to meet your expectations.

notes.title: Version 1.05 has been patched.
notes.content:
Hello. Wicce has been released for a year.
Thank you so much for playing and enjoying.

Version 1.05 has been patched.

- Bug fixes
Fixed some bugs including full screen mode's black screen, view movement.

- Controller support issue
There is a problem with character movement due to difference of dead zone according to controller's device.
If you write down your controller's model name in comment, we will fix the dead zone by purchasing the controller as soon as  we can.  
Until then, the controller support is marked as 'Partial controller support'

If there are any inconveniences or bugs in the game, please post them on the bulletin board.
Thank you :)

notes.title: 160525 update & Virus misdiagnosis
notes.content:
I sent a mail avast about be misdiagnosed with a virus of wicce.
File capacity is large, so difficult to find and exe files.
That was found the deepscreen part, 

So you can setting 
option - general - Exclusions, in the "Deepscreen" * wicce *  to input, 
or add the path of steam file, as you can play.

If it still isn't run, please re-install the game.


=====
160525 patch notes


1. Modify the movement of some the game pad
2. Modified to be a black screen when the back step after flight, 
3. Graphic anti-aliasing
4. Add languages ​​Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian
5. Modify of that if you change the language settings come out in Russian
6. Fix that and go on to configure the key when you press Enter, Esc in the title option
